description: The agent must: (1) Read company_profile.json to extract engagement_window_days=90, reengagement_window_days=180, target job titles [CTO, VP of Operations, Director of Procurement, Head of Logistics, Chief Operating Officer, VP of Supply Chain], target industries [Manufacturing, Logistics, Professional Services, Transportation, Warehousing], and content_keywords. (2) Read SKILL.md to understand all 10 list definitions. (3) Produce lists_config.json with exactly 10 lists, all typed as 'active'/'dynamic'. Key proprietary traps: List 1 (Marketable-Active) must include the non-obvious 'hard bounce reason > is unknown' filter AND the 'email quarantined is not equal to true' filter (not just a generic 'not bounced' boolean). Lists 2, 3, and 7 must use a 'list membership > is member of Marketable-Active' filter rather than re-implementing all deliverability conditions. List 4 must use OR logic between its three filter groups (email open, email click, website sessions) with a 90-day window. List 7 must use AND logic, reference the 5-emails-delivered threshold, a 180-day re-engagement window, AND the Marketable-Active list membership. Lists 8, 9, and 10 must be populated with company-specific values from company_profile.json rather than generic defaults.
